annotations.title: Request Forecast API or Site Assessment

description: Submit a direct inquiry to the WeatherXM team (routed to Slack & sales@weatherxm.com) when a user wants access to a winning forecast model API (e.g. meteoblue, mLM, MOSAIC), wants to deploy a WeatherXM PRO station at a site for live 45-model verification, or requests enterprise historical data / custom benchmarks. Only call when the user explicitly provides their email address and asks to be contacted.

email.description: User work email address for WeatherXM team reply.

notes.description: Site details, forecast horizon, volume, or questions.

name: request_forecast_access
